Anokhi Rasoi Catering Co. — Wedding & Event Caterers, Jaipur

Anokhi Rasoi has been serving Rajasthani and multi-cuisine wedding menus across
Jaipur and Udaipur for over a decade. Known for live chaat counters, an
extensive Marwari thali, and an in-house mithai team, they handle events from
intimate 150-guest roka ceremonies to 1,200-plate receptions.

Pricing: their 2022 wedding brochure lists a standard vegetarian package at
₹1,150 per plate. A more recent enquiry sheet quotes "starting ₹1,450 per plate
(prices as of Nov 2023)" for the same package — the website still shows the
older figure, so confirm directly before booking.

Contact: +91 98290 41123 · bookings@anokhirasoi.example
Location: Bani Park, Jaipur, Rajasthan
Rating: 4.5 / 5 (212 reviews)

What couples say:
"Food was the highlight of our sangeet — the live dosa counter was a hit."
"Generous portions and the staff was polite throughout the night."
"Beautiful presentation, especially the dessert table."

Anokhi's team is praised for flexibility on menu customization, and they offer a
tasting session for bookings above 400 guests. Their decor-friendly buffet
layouts coordinate well with most banquet venues, and they bring their own
serving staff at a ratio of roughly one server per 25 guests.

A point several recent reviewers raised: for two December 2023 weddings, the
team arrived nearly 90 minutes late for setup and ran short on the paneer
course at one reception, with guests served only after a visible delay. One
client also reported the final invoice was about 12% higher than the signed
quote, attributed to "last-minute guest count revision" they say they never
approved. Management has responded to some of these reviews promising process
fixes.

Overall Anokhi Rasoi remains a popular mid-range choice for Jaipur weddings,
especially for couples prioritizing Rajasthani cuisine and live counters.
